backup.production_rule: Two NEW functions only (raise_work_order_v1, guest_context_v1). No table, grant on existing objects, or data touched. Take the backup, fill restore_point/verified_at, apply within one hour.

forward_verification.name: raise_work_order_exists_for_service_role
forward_verification.query: select has_function_privilege('service_role', 'public.raise_work_order_v1(uuid, text, text, text, text, text)', 'execute')

forward_verification.name: raise_work_order_denied_to_authenticated
forward_verification.query: select not has_function_privilege('authenticated', 'public.raise_work_order_v1(uuid, text, text, text, text, text)', 'execute')

forward_verification.name: guest_context_reads_urgent_note
forward_verification.query: select public.guest_context_v1('6ae230f4-c189-4547-84b1-cb6e0b2cc9bd', null, 'Dale Anwen De La Cerna')->>'last_issue' = 'gatulo ubos sa aircon'

rollback.safe_until: always (drops two new functions; raised work orders stay as rows)

feature_flags.name: edge_functions_call_rpcs
feature_flags.required_state: submit-cleaning, messenger-concierge, airbnb-email-sync, submit-booking and telegram-cassy call the RPCs and only warn when absent; deploy order does not matter.

compatibility.evidence: New functions only. Edge Functions tolerate the RPC missing (console.warn). Rehearse on Alfred before apply.

stop_conditions: any forward verification query returns anything other than its expected value
the restore point is older than one hour
